concept: B 折角藏叶：珊瑚红折纸回环，右上折角露出鼠尾草绿纸张背面，奶油白圆角底板。
reference: The selected center B icon from the POMODOT origami comparison board.
prompt: Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the middle B icon as one standalone production desktop application icon. Preserve the coral origami loop with its upper-right opening, original fold geometry, warm ivory rounded-square tile, matte paper texture, soft interior shadows, and tiny muted sage-green reverse-side paper sliver tucked behind the upper-right coral fold. No separate leaf, stem, veins, dot, text, labels or thumbnails. Straight-on view, square canvas, centered tile with equal transparent margins. Keep the tile opaque ivory and the exterior genuinely transparent.
finalCleanupPrompt: Precise production cleanup of the attached selected B app icon. Preserve the artwork inside the ivory tile exactly: coral-red origami circular ribbon with open upper-right gap and the tiny integrated sage reverse-side fold; preserve shape, materials, colors, and placement. Change ONLY the outer boundary and exterior alpha: remove EVERY stray detached pixel, white fringe, speckle, and fragment around the tile. Produce a single continuous perfectly clean antialiased rounded-square ivory tile silhouette, without any outer drop shadow, without any halo, with all pixels outside the tile fully transparent. This is an application icon master, not a photo cutout: outer edges must be crisp mathematically smooth rounded-square edges, clean alpha. Keep the existing realistic subtle shadows INSIDE the tile only. Maintain square canvas, tile centered with equal transparent margin approximately 8 percent on all sides. No text. Do not add objects or change the symbol. Output one transparent square icon.
exports: Run node scripts/generate-icons.mjs on macOS to rebuild ICNS, multi-resolution ICO and tray PNG from the 1024px master.
